jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description: Overview Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering. Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit. The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era. We have one product: new physics, at scale. Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact. Â Role and Responsibilities Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting. The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on. Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first. We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit. What We're Looking For A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials. Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list. You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently. A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically. Nice to Have Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security. Experience in research or scientific computing environments. Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem. Â How We Work We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage. Â Location and Compensation This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery. jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Defence, DACH
jobs.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the DACH region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s defence business across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the wider European region, with Germany as the main focus. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's defence and security organisations adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence and the public sector. These customers need AI that runs on their own infrastructure, often air-gapped or at the tactical edge, and that can handle classified information. SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits: Technical experts in the field Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues Product evangelists of Cohere technology Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products. In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers. You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams. A typical day at Cohere might include: Leading the technical talk track on customer calls. Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments, including on-prem, air-gapped and sovereign cloud setups that meet German and EU requirements such as GDPR, BSI C5 and the EU AI Act. Designing for classified and disconnected environments (VS-NfD and above, air-gapped, DDIL and tactical edge), together with the customer's IT security and accreditation teams. Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology. Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption. Translating defence and operational requirements into AI use cases, from logistics, maintenance and training to intelligence analysis and staff work. Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack Owning the technical response of RFPs and public tenders, including defence procurement, from security questionnaires to mapping the customer's requirements specification (Lastenheft) to our solution. Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere. Collaborating with the Product and Engineering team

jobs.description: <p><strong>THE POSITION<br></strong>Our roster has an opening with your name on it</p> <p>Much of what decides whether a fan stays with FanDuel happens either side of the bet: the sign-up that takes a minute, the deposit that clears first time on a Sunday afternoon, the withdrawal that lands when we said it would, and the protections that work quietly in the background for the people who need them.</p> <p>We are looking for a Software Engineering Director to lead the teams behind that experience across FanDuel’s Customer Product Engineering (CPE) domain.</p> <p>CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalisation and marketing messaging that shape every fan’s day-to-day experience. When CPE works, nobody notices. When it does not, a fan cannot get in, get funded, get paid or get looked after, and quality elsewhere in the product does not make up for it.</p> <p>The mission: make it quick and predictable for every fan to join, fund an account, get paid and be protected, in every jurisdiction we operate in, on the busiest day of the sporting calendar. Making every moment more, for our customers. Your work always follows our principle <em>Everything Begins with the Customer.</em></p> <p>That means designing for extreme, event-driven peak load, where traffic arrives in minutes, and for a heavily regulated environment in which auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. It also means depending on other people’s systems: payment providers, identity and KYC vendors, geolocation suppliers. You build so that their bad day does not become our customers’ bad day.</p> <p>This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead managers and senior engineers across several teams, set technical direction alongside your Principal and Senior Staff Engineers, make the difficult calls that do not have obvious answers, and create the conditions in which good teams do the best work of their careers. You will work as closely with Product, Compliance, Risk, Finance and Customer Operations as you do with engineers, and you can explain a technical trade-off to an executive audience without diluting it.</p> <p>You are candid about what is not working and you know when to look for consensus and when the decision is yours, <em>Challenge and Commit.</em> You wear your FanDuel hat first and do not restrict yourself to organisational boundaries, <em>We are One Team.</em> You are a visible part of the domain leadership team and a role model to the wider engineering community, <em>Humble and Hungry.</em></p> <p><strong>THE GAME PLAN</strong><br>Everyone on our team has a part to play</p> <ul> <li>Lead multiple engineering teams within CPE, setting a clear technical vision for each area and holding delivery to it.</li> <li>Own the customer outcomes your teams are accountable for, measured where the fan feels them: registration and verification completion, time to first bet, deposit and withdrawal success rates, payout speed, geolocation pass rates, and the availability of whole journeys rather than the uptime of individual services.</li> <li>Set the standard for availability and operational excellence in a domain where an outage stops the rest of the product working, including the KPIs, the instrumentation behind them, and the discipline to tell genuine degradation from noise.</li> <li>Prepare for event-driven peak load so that the biggest days in the sporting calendar are rehearsed, with capacity, failover and degradation behaviour proven in advance.</li> <li>Reduce the blast radius of third-party failure across paymen

We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. About the Role The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support. We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution. Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. jobs.title: Senior Photonics Engineer, Optical Interfaces
jobs.description: <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum’s&nbsp;mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our architecture and approach&nbsp;is&nbsp;based on silicon photonics. By&nbsp;leveraging&nbsp;the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons&nbsp;don’t&nbsp;feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">In 2024,&nbsp;PsiQuantum&nbsp;announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum&nbsp;also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It&nbsp;represents&nbsp;a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be&nbsp;solved&nbsp;any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear&nbsp;path&nbsp;to make it real.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Come join us.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Photonics Engineer to develop ultra-low-loss optical interface solutions between dissimilar, exploratory, waveguiding platforms. This role combines device concept development, optical simulation, and hands-on experimental validation to assess and mature new approaches for mode conversion and coupling. The successful candidate will combine creativity in photonic device design with strong engineering judgement, identifying solutions that are both high-performing and practical to deploy. Working closely with internal teams and expert external partners, they will help guide the development of advanced optical interfaces. We welcome applicants from both advanced industrial photonics environments and leading research groups who combine strong physical intuition with practical experimental and engineering judgement.</p>

Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our architecture and approach&nbsp;is&nbsp;based on silicon photonics. By&nbsp;leveraging&nbsp;the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons&nbsp;don’t&nbsp;feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">In 2024,&nbsp;PsiQuantum&nbsp;announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum&nbsp;also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It&nbsp;represents&nbsp;a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be&nbsp;solved&nbsp;any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear&nbsp;path&nbsp;to make it real.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Come join us.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Optical Fibre Engineer to develop and evaluate advanced optical fibre for high-performance optical systems. This role combines optical modelling, deep understanding of advanced speciality optical fibre behaviour and design tradeoffs, and hands-on experimental validation, including the measurement and verification of key fibre properties. The successful candidate will work with internal teams with diverse technical expertise, and external partners, to translate performance requirements into practical technical direction for advanced fibre technologies. We welcome candidates from both advanced industrial photonics environments and leading research groups who combine strong physical intuition with practical experimental and engineering judgement.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus. We support more than 250 million square metres of property, retain over 98% of our customers, profitable and growing at double digits year on year with backing from K1 Investment Management. Our customers already include seven of Europe’s ten largest logistics platforms, the five leading global commercial real estate advisers and 17 of Europe’s top 20 facilities management providers. What To Expect A defined greenfield territory of named target accounts Reference customers with genuine weight in the market and proof points that survive scrutiny. Generate the majority of your own pipeline, at coverage that supports next year’s number rather than this quarter’s. Business development and marketing will contribute; they will not carry you. Winning Complex Enterprise Deals Run the full cycle: first conversation, discovery, business case, evaluation, negotiation and signature. Displace incumbent CAFM and IWMS platforms, in-house systems and entrenched spreadsheet processes. Navigate multi-country buying groups, procurement, IT security and legal without losing momentum. Qualify hard using MEDDICC and with mutual action plans on every live deal. Shape commercial structure: pricing, multi-year terms, phased rollouts and land-and-expand entry points that create a platform for growth. Sell what we can deliver and hand over cleanly. Executive Credibility Earn access to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, Heads of Real Estate and workplace and transformation sponsors, and hold the room once you are in it. Lead with the commercial case: operating cost, compliance exposure, portfolio performance and risk, rather than a feature demonstration. Mobilise Presales, Product and executive sponsorship around the opportunities that justify it. Forecast and Commercia

jobs.title: Director, CRM
jobs.description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose CRM at Neko is a newer but critical function, and this role exists to define its strategy and turn it into one of the company's core growth engines. You will be accountable for the CRM outcomes that matter most as we bring proactive, preventive healthcare to billions of people: converting leads and the waitlist into booked scans and bringing members back for their next scan and their next referral. This isn't stewarding an established machine. You will set the vision, the operating model, and the investment case, scale the implementation of our CRM platform and practices across markets, and build the organization that delivers it – to the same standard of excellence and care our clinics deliver in person. You will lead through others, building and directing a multi-market team, and work with Marketing, Comms, and Product, alongside other business functions. You will influence executive decisions on growth and be accountable for CRM's financial contribution to the business. In the early months, you will be close to the work: operating the platform, shaping test briefs and making content calls alongside the team, while you hire the people to take on more of the day-to-day work. You will report to the Senior Director of Growth. Where we are today CRM at Neko is at an early stage. Today the function is a small team running email and SMS, with the potential to implement and optimize the right messaging at every stage. We are currently implementing Braze over Q4 2026. Neko is also scaling after its US launch – a key market for Neko, with CRM being a key factor in our success here. You will join while the foundations are being laid, with the mandate to shape them. What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 months Set the long-term CRM strategy: define a multi-market vision and roadmap across acquisition, conversion, and retention, with investment cases and success measures agreed with Growth leadership. Own the growth outcomes: be accountable for CRM's measurable contribution to bookings, rebooking, referral, and revenue, with baselines set and targets agreed with senior leadership. Design CRM as one coherent program: nurture, lifecycle, and re-engagement working together across every live channel, with performance visible at each funnel stage. Scale CRM for the US and beyond: build a repeatable playbook for new cities and markets, including regional compliance and localization. Make test-and-learn the standard: set the experimentation framework and ensure results change decisions. Build the organization: hire the first layer of the CRM function, creating a high-performing team, including leads and managers, define the structure by region, channel or lifecycle stage, and grow future leaders. Own budget, vendors, and tooling: manage the CRM budget, stack, and vendor relationships, and make the build, buy, and prioritization calls. Minimum Qualifications Extensive experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, including hiring and leading a team, starting from a small base Track record of setting CRM strategy and owning business outcomes (bookings, retention, LTV, revenue), not just channel or campaign metrics Experience leading a CRM function through transformation or scale-up, including organization design, operating model and infrastructure Proven experience running structured experimentation at scale and changing direction based on results Confidence

jobs.title: FFE Design Lead
jobs.description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose The FF+E Design Lead will own the development and stewardship of Neko Health’s global furniture, fixtures, equipment, and accessories strategy — defining the physical objects, materials, and product selections that shape the member experience across every Neko location worldwide. Working within the Architecture Creative Leads team, this role sits at the intersection of interior design, physical user experience, and procurement strategy. Your primary focus is establishing a scalable, globally consistent FF+E standard that ensures every Neko space feels considered, cohesive, and unmistakably Neko. You will develop FF+E and accessories standards for the Location Design Playbook, drive product development and selection and provide concept-level creative guidance to regional design teams delivering projects globally. This role reports to the Architecture Creative Studio Lead and partners closely with the Architecture Design Studio Leads for the US and Europe, the Industrial Design Lead, and cross-functional teams in Hardware, Operations, Brand, and Procurement. What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months Comprehensive global standards, documented in the Location Design Playbook — covering furniture, fixtures, accessories, for all key clinic zones — with clear specifications, product lists, and sourcing guidance ready for regional teams to implement. A scalable procurement and vendor strategy for FF+E, with preferred suppliers identified globally and regionally, supporting consistent quality, cost efficiency, and lead-time reliability across markets. Concept-level FF+E guidance on at least two active regional projects, ensuring selections align with Neko’s design language and experience principles while adapting to local availability and requirements. Contribute to the development of bespoke FF+E and accessory items that cannot be sourced off-the-shelf — collaborating with the Industrial Design Lead and external vendors to develop proprietary solutions that reinforce the Neko brand. Minimum Requirements Degree in Interior Design, Product Design, Furniture Design, Industrial Design, Architecture, or related field. 8+ years of experience in FF+E design, specification, and procurement, with a portfolio demonstrating a strong eye for material quality, detail, and cohesive design language. Demonstrated experience developing FF+E standards, product libraries, or specification playbooks for a multi-site, global or scaling organization. A keen eye for colour, material and finishes. Deep understanding of bespoke furniture and product manufacturing methods — materials, finishes, construction methods, durability and sustainability considerations. Experience managing vendor relationships and procurement processes, including sourcing, sampling, cost negotiation and quality control across multiple markets. Strong understanding of ergonomics, accessibility, and relevant product safety and compliance standards within a commercial retail environment. Excellent communication skills — able to articulate design intent and product rationale to both creative and operational audiences, and comfortable presenting to leadership. Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, scaling environment where standards are still being built and processes are evolving. Alignment with Neko’s studio culture: enablers not heroes, creative problem solvers, craft-driven. Preferred Experience craft

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a Senior Recruiting Coordinator to our team. In this position, you will play a critical role in creating a thoughtful, organized, and high-quality recruiting experience from the first candidate interaction through the interview process. You will partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications and logistics, and keep the hiring process moving. Our Senior Recruiting Coordinators play an important role in shaping how candidates experience CesiumAstro. For many candidates, you will be one of their first interactions with the company and one of the first faces they meet onsite. How we communicate, how prepared we are, and how we show up throughout the process matters. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of those details and represents our culture with professionalism, urgency, and care. This is a fast moving role that requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and strong communication. The ideal candidate is a true team player who can quickly understand business needs, stay ahead of competing priorities, and take pride in delivering a high quality experience for candidates and internal teams alike   JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and CesiumAstro staff, ensuring a positive experience for all parties. Manage job postings on various platforms, including the company website and external job boards. This will include drafting job postings and other recruitment-related materials as well as posting and maintaining job listings on state job boards in alignment with Affirmative Action (AA) and compliance guidelines. Maintain and update the applicant tracking system (ATS) with candidate information and status updates. Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely updates. Support the onboarding process by conducting pre-employment background checks, drug screens, and coordinating start dates.   Pull reports on recruitment metrics through our ATS, Lever. Collaborate with the recruitment team on candidate experience. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Associate's degree or equivalent relevant experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience in recruiting or related business administration. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc., and familiarity with ATS systems (Lever preferred). Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment. A positive attitude, team-oriented, and a passion for recruitment. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. A high level of integrity and respect for confidentiality. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Passion for the space industry. Experience working in a start-up or small company. Experience at high-tech companies. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organisation. Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agen

jobs.description: <p><strong>The Firm</strong></p> <p>XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 50,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 250 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with 650 petabytes of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork, and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Realtime Analytics and Controls Developer, you will be responsible for the mission control panel for one of the largest trading systems in the world ($250bn-300bn/day). Your work will have a company-wide impact, with users including Trading Desk, Trading Developers, Quants, CEO, Distribution and Risk.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The goal is to provide clarity about what our trading system (hundreds of thousands of strategies) is doing at any given moment and how it is performing. We supply both high-level and incredibly detailed views, as both are crucial for efficient decision making and spotting issues. In addition to visibility, we are also responsible for trading control mechanisms – e.g., tweaking limits, starting trading strategies or emergency stopping. These actions are necessary for continued trading, and sometimes need to be taken within minutes, with millions of pounds at stake.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Realtime Analytics and Controls is a small specialist tam which works directly with multiple front office groups. You will be expected to also contribute to the shared software platform that supports this group.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This is one of our most people-oriented engineering roles. You should expect to collaborate regularly with your colleagues who are the primary customers of your software, to understand how your design decisions affect their day-to-day work.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communicate regularly with internal users about their needs a

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: <p>CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.&nbsp;</p> <p>CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit <a href="https://www.chaosinc.com">www.chaosinc.com</a>.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>You’ll join a small, highly collaborative team working across London and San Francisco, building the software behind some of the world’s most advanced radar systems.</p> <p>Working alongside software, hardware, and systems engineers, and the teams who take these systems into the field, you’ll design the backend services, data pipelines, and operator-facing applications that turn raw sensor data into decisions people can act on.</p> <p>The systems you build must be reliable, resilient, secure, and performant - enabling operators to depend on them in the environments where they matter most.</p> <p>This is a high-ownership role where you’ll influence architecture and help define the engineering foundations of a rapidly evolving platform. We’re looking for engineers who enjoy scaling distributed systems and solving hard data problems.</p> <h2>What You’ll Build</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Backend Services</strong>&nbsp;- develop high-performance Python services that ingest, process, and distribute real-time sensor data with low latency, high reliability, and security at scale.</li> <li><strong>Operator Interfaces</strong>&nbsp;- build and evolve the web applications operators use to monitor live missions and investigate what the sensors saw (TypeScript and React).</li> <li><strong>Cloud Platform</strong>&nbsp;- design and build secure, scalable Azure services that power distributed radar systems, defining the infrastructure as code and instrumentation for the systems you own.</li> <li><strong>Platform Architecture</strong>&nbsp;- help shape the technical direction of the platform, making architectural decisions that support new capabilities, increasing scale, and long-term maintainability.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>We’re looking for exceptional software engineers who are excited by solving hard technical problems and building systems that matter. You don’t need experience with every technology we use - we value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.</p> <p>You’ll thrive in this role if you:</p> <ul> <li>Enjoy building scalable backend systems and taking ownership of production services.</li> <li>Enjoy solving complex distributed systems and real-time data challenges.</li> <li>Are eager to learn new technologies and adapt to new technical domains.</li> <li>Care deeply about reliability, security, and scalability.</li> <li>Get real leverage from AI coding tools, with a considered view on what to delegate to them and what not to.</li> <li>Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across teams.</li> <li>Are motivated by building technology with meaningful real-world impact.</li> </ul> <h2>Requirements</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Right to work in the UK.</strong></li> <li><strong>Willingness to travel.</strong

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager - London
jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. Part technical advisor, part incident lead, part operating model owner, you hold the technical health of Legora's most complex client relationships and define the playbook the whole function runs on. What you’ll do Own the relationship: Hold the technical health and escalation outcomes for our Strategic Accounts, serving as their primary point of escalation and continuity, and read usage and adoption signals to get ahead of risk. Lead in a crisis: Act as incident lead on Sev1 and Sev2 events, owning coordination, customer communication, and the path to resolution. Drive post-incident reviews as trust-building artifacts and product feedback loops, not just process checkboxes. Set the standard: Define and own the escalation criteria, account-health model, and cross-team interfaces the function runs on. Build mechanisms that make the team consistent and not dependent on individual heroics. Own the Technical Blueprint: Maintain the single source of truth for each account, including data setup, integrations, security and legal considerations, and workflow context. Carry technical context from implementation into the live relationship so nothing is lost in the handoff and the whole account team can rely on it. Drive adoption and enablement: Run technical reviews and enablement sessions that deepen product usage, unlock new value, and keep customers current on the platform. Partner proactively: Work with Engagement Managers (CSM function) on Quarterly Business Reviews that tie technical health to business outcomes. Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel. Stay close to the signal: Own the highest-stakes cases in the L2 queue for your assigned Strategic Accounts, and serve as the escalation point for Platform Consultants before an issue reaches the Technical Platform Expert, so you stay close to the ground truth of each account's technical health. What you bring You have owned strategic, high-value B2B accounts and kept clients confident when things went wrong. You have led incident response or major escalations under pressure, start to finish. You communicate with executives as clearly as with engineers: confirmed facts, explicit trade-offs, named owners, and no speculation

jobs.title: AI Client Executive
jobs.description: Who we are At Supermodular AI, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution. Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization. That's why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled. Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you'll feel at home at Supermodular AI. Your role As an AI Client Executive at supermodular.ai , you will own the development of strategic enterprise relationships and turn complex AI transformation opportunities into meaningful, long-term engagements. You will work directly with senior technology and business leaders to understand where AI can create material impact in their organizations. This means going beyond selling predefined services. You will need to understand how an organization operates, identify the problems worth solving, and work with our technical team to turn those problems into engagements we can execute. You will own the commercial relationship from the first conversation through closing and account expansion. You will create new opportunities, lead executive conversations, navigate complex buying organizations, and build the commercial case for working together. Many of the opportunities you pursue will not be clearly defined at the start. Customers may know they need to transform with AI without knowing where to begin, what to build, or how to operationalize it. Your role is to bring structure to that ambiguity, identify where we can create meaningful value, and build the relationships and momentum required to turn that opportunity into action. What you own Build your own pipeline through direct outreach, your network, referrals and strategic partnerships. Develop relationships with technology partners and turn them into joint opportunities and introductions. Open and develop relationships with senior technology and business leaders at target accounts. Lead discovery to understand priorities, uncover meaningful problems and qualify opportunities. Turn early conversations into clear opportunities with defined value, stakeholders and a path forward. Work with our technical team to shape the right engagement for the client. Own the commercial process from proposal through negotiation and close. Navigate stakeholders, procurement and other enterprise buying processes to maintain momentum. Grow initial engagements into larger, long-term client relationships. Own revenue across both new and existing clients. What you bring You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals. You have owned meaningful revenue targets and are comfortable being accountable for pipeline, closing and account growth. You know how to create new opportunities rather than relying on inbound leads or an established sales machine. You can build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. In this individual contributor role, you will bring deep technical accounting mastery to a high-tempo Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment, tackling complex enterprise contracts and massive transaction data. You will work closely alongside Deal Desk (our sales contract structuring team), Sales Operations, Legal, Product, and the broader finance team. Together, we ensure seamless IFRS 15 compliance while continually reimagining and optimizing our global revenue engine. Automate large-scale reconciliations between source systems and the general ledger, identifying and resolving discrepancies in real-time. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to streamline efficiency and enhance revenue recognition processes within complex contracts. Implement best practices to elevate overall financial efficiency and precision. Drive full automation and optimization across revenue workflows. Compliance and Audit Ensure strict compliance with all relevant accounting standards and regulatory requirements. Coordinate directly with internal and external auditors during audits and reviews. Basic Qualifications MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent depth of applied experience. jobs.title: CDI - BARISTA - Flagship Le Marais
jobs.description: AMI cherche un.e nouvel.le ambassadeur.drice BARISTA pour rejoindre notre Flagship du Marais . Chez AMI, nous avons à cœur de créer une expérience client à la fois chaleureuse, authentique et exigeante, à l’image de notre Maison. Sous la responsabilité du Store Manager, vous contribuez à offrir une expérience accueillante et qualitative à nos clients à travers la préparation et le service des boissons, tout en veillant à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement de l’espace Café de la boutique. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :   Accueil et relation client Accueillir chaque client, conseiller sur la carte, créer une expérience à la hauteur de l'image de la Maison Assurer la fluidité du service en période d'affluence Faire le lien avec les équipes de la boutique : le Café et le Retail partagent le même espace et la même clientèle Préparation des boissons Extraction espresso, boissons lactées et latte art. Création de recettes d'espresso et de filtre pour chaque nouveau café. Réglages quotidiens du moulin et de la machine, contrôle de la constance tout au long du service Dégustation et ajustement des recettes, participation aux évolutions de la carte Gestion des stocks et des achats Suivi des niveaux de stock (café, lait, consommables, packaging) Passage des commandes fournisseurs et relation directe avec eux (torréfacteur, grossistes, consommables) Réception et contrôle des livraisons, gestion des DLC, limitation des pertes Inventaires réguliers et remontée des écarts Gestion du matériel Nettoyage quotidien et hebdomadaire des machines, du moulin et de l'ensemble du poste Planification et suivi des maintenances préventives, gestion de la relation avec les techniciens Détection et signalement des dysfonctionnements, gestion des interventions curatives Respect et suivi des règles d'hygiène applicables au poste Encadrement Encadrer et former le second barista : gestes techniques, standards de service, montée en compétence Organiser les plannings du binôme et la répartition des tâches Participer aux recrutements à venir : définition du besoin, entretiens, intégration des nouveaux arrivants Expérience confirmée en tant que barista en coffee shop de spécialité (2 à 3 ans minimum) -Maîtrise technique : réglages, extraction, latte art -Autonomie démontrée sur les stocks et la relation fournisseurs -À l'aise avec l'entretien et la maintenance courante du matériel -Connaissance de la filière café de spécialité (torréfacteurs, sourcing, tendances) Vous êtes curieux.se et avez envie de vous investir dans un tout nouveau projet. Vous êtes souriant.e, dynamique, impliqué.e et doté.e d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. Vous avez un sens développé du service client et avez à cœur de satisfaire les besoins de la clientèle. Vous avez une forte sensibilité pour la Mode et à l'univers de la marque La pratique de l'anglais est indispensable . Date de démarrage : 15 novembre. Why join the « F.ami.LY »? Ami Paris se distingue par la sincérité de son expression. Nous réunissons des personnes passionnées et motivées, qui travaillent avec cœur et une énergie positive dans un cadre respectueux. Chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à créer un environnement dynamique, ou créativité et engagement vont de pair. Rejoignez une Maison de mode en pleine croissance, engagée et bienveillante, où chacun peut apporter sa personnalité et contribuer à une aventure collective. Nous recherchons des personnalités qui savent créer du lien, prendre des initiatives et faire preuve d’implication. Chez Ami, la qualité de l’expérience client repose autant sur le savoir-faire que sur le savoir-être : confiance, optimisme, créativité, engagement et esprit d’équipe. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.   Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Ready for a Work-Life Upgrade under the Mediterranean Sun? Imagine swapping cold commutes and grey skies for morning frappés, after-work dips in the Aegean, and weekends exploring island hideaways or ancient historic streets. If you speak Japanese and have been dreaming of an exciting international fresh start, this is your sign! At Next Job Abroad , we don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. We partner with leading international customer experience hubs in Greece working with some of the world’s most recognized brands (think top-tier tech, e-commerce, gaming, travel, and automotive giants). Together, we make sure you land in a role that fits your background, strengths, and long-term goals. Deliver Top-Class Service: Turn tricky situations into positive customer moments through clear, empathetic, and friendly communication. Troubleshoot & Guide: Walk users through basic technical issues, service setups, or account features step-by-step. Collaborate Globally: Work side-by-side with international colleagues in an inspiring, multicultural environment. Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest brand features, tools, and updates with ongoing support. Requirements Fluency in Japanese: Native or fluent (C1/C2 level) in both written and spoken communication. Good English Knowledge: (B2 level or higher) to navigate company systems and communicate with international team members. Work Eligibility: EU Passport or a valid legal work permit for Greece. Age Requirement: At least 18 years old. Digital Literacy: Comfortable navigating computers, multi-screen environments, and basic software applications. Soft Skills: Strong communication skills, active listening, empathy, and a positive problem-solving mindset. Relocation Readiness: Willingness and motivation to relocate to Greece in the coming weeks. Benefits 14 Salaries per Year: In Greece, you receive extra salary bonuses for Easter, Summer, and Christmas! Monthly Performance Bonuses: Extra financial rewards based on your achievements and team KPIs. Full Relocation Support: Flight tickets booked to Greece Complimentary hotel or apartment stay upon arrival Dedicated assistance with local paperwork (AFM tax number, social security, bank accounts) Real estate guidance to help you find your permanent apartment in Athens Paid Professional Training: Comprehensive onboarding program to get you fully confident before taking your first customer inquiry. Career Progression: Clear growth paths into Quality Assurance, Team Leadership, Training, or Operations within major global companies. Mediterranean Lifestyle: Over 300 days of sunshine a year, vibrant city life, world-famous cuisine, and incredible beaches right on your doorstep. A Recruitment Process Built Around Your Profile We know moving to another country is a big decision, so we make the journey smooth and completely transparent: Application: Submit your CV in English or Japanese. Personal Consultation: A friendly 1-on-1 interview with the recruitment team at Next Job Abroad to discuss your experience, interests, and preferred project types. Profile Matching: We match your background with current active openings in Greece and present you directly to the best-fit opportunity. Guidance & Placement: We guide you through the client interview, offer confirmation, relocation logistics, and onboarding—every single step of the way! Why Athens, Greece? jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle bei June Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. So arbeiten wir Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team

jobs.title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
jobs.description: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible . Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep. That's your world. As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm. You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency. You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track. Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team. To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter. What convinces us Your personality, paired with: 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems - this is your core strength Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent) Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. Additionally, we offer: great freedom for your creative ideas. ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment. Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design. support with your relocation a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side. 30-day vacation by default. an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day. attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program. unforgettable moments at our company events and team events. How to reach us If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alin

jobs.title: Tracking Specialist Intern
jobs.description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: The Data & Measurement team makes sure every interaction on our website and apps is measured accurately, reliably and in a privacy-compliant way. We own the tracking architecture (Google Tag Manager web and server-side, GA4, advertising platform tags) across 17 markets. The data we collect powers marketing performance, product analytics and business decisions across the company. Be a part of the movement. Join the circular revolution. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Implement and maintain tags, triggers and variables in our Google Tag Manager containers (web and server-side), for analytics and advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta. Specify and QA dataLayer events with our developers, and make sure new features ship with the right tracking. Run tracking audits and QA across markets: detect broken or missing events, investigate data discrepancies, and follow fixes through to production. Contribute to tracking monitoring by building checks and alerts on data quality in BigQuery. Make sure tracking respects user consent choices and privacy regulations, working with our consent management platform and legal teams. Keep our tracking plan and documentation up to date, so every team knows what is collected and why. Answer tracking questions from Marketing, Product and Data teams, and help them trust the numbers. YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ You are in the final year of a Master's degree in engineering, business, data or digital marketing (or equivalent), looking for a 6-month internship. You have a first experience or a strong interest in web analytics and tag management (GTM, GA4 or similar). You understand JavaScript and can read, debug and write simple scripts, and you are comfortable with HTML and browser developer tools. You know some SQL, or want to get hands-on with BigQuery. You care about data quality and details, and enjoy investigating why a number looks wrong. You have an interest in privacy and consent topics (GDPR, cookies, CMPs). You communicate clearly and are comfortable working with developers, marketers and analysts. You are fluent in French and English (both are mandatory). BONUS POINT : Knowledge of server-side tagging, experience with an advertising platform (Google Ads, Meta), or a personal project involving tracking or data. ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: Start date: January 2027 Duration : 6 months Full-time internship (35h/week) Location : Paris (France) RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅 Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min) Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min) Cultural fit interview with the manager (30min) WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employe

jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio company. Why we exist Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling . Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach. So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation. 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack. Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027. The role This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute , our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work. You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer. What you'll do Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation. Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators. Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds. Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers. Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class. Be the face of it. Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure. You might be the one if You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought. You've sold, built or run serious infrastructure in the neocloud, AI infra, CSP or hyperscale data center world, and you've closed the kind of deals that move megawatts. We care about what you've shipped, not what your business card said. You know GPU economics inside out. H100 / B200 / GB200 cluster economics, orchestration, workload constraints. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals. You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall. You've built something from zero. You've scaled a business line, closed complex multi-million infrastructure contracts and thrived with high autonomy and high ambiguity. The ocean pulls at you. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
jobs.description: Hey, I'm Adrian . I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash. Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships. Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible. That’s where you come in. Why we're hiring Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators. The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API. We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production. You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation. If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog . What you'll actually own 1. Make creator search meaningfully better. You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them. 2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence. You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience. 3. Ship new search capabilities into production. You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters. 4. Own the system end to end. You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks. What the day-to-day looks like Here’s what a typical week might include: Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement. Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost. Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators. Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production. Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence. We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch. Requirements What you've done
