Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes. jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description: Senior Network Developer About Share Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served. The Role Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices. You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team. What you'll do Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time. Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist. Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable. Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change. Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop. Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system. Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off. Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you. Our Ideal Candidate 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP. Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit. Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense. Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you. You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe. You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed. AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't. You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network. A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders. Nice to have Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale. Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description: Network Operations Engineer 1. About the role Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it. For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar. We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling. The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes. You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it. 2. What you'll do Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing. Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with. Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state. Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online. Move the work forward. You are part of the network team

Du verhandelst Preise, Projektvolumina, Kapazitäten und Rahmenbedingungen mit unseren Handwerkspartnern und stellst wirtschaftlich attraktive und langfristig erfolgreiche Partnerschaften sicher. Du bindest OEMs und Großhandel strategisch in unser Partner-Ökosystem ein und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Konditionen für 42watt und unsere Handwerkspartner. Du entwickelst unser Partnernetzwerk datengetrieben weiter und steuerst es entlang von Kapazitätsbedarfen, regionaler Abdeckung, Auslastung sowie der Segmentierung und Entwicklung einzelner Partner. Du entwickelst die relevanten KPIs und Steuerungsmechanismen , um Performance, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit unseres Partnernetzwerks transparent zu machen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du führst und entwickelst unser Partnerships-Team , setzt klare Ziele und schaffst die Strukturen, mit denen das Team und unser Partnernetzwerk gemeinsam mit 42watt skalieren . Dein Profil Erfahrung im Partner-/Account-Management: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Partner- oder Account-Management mit (operativer oder Einkaufs-Schwerpunkt), idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld. Verhandlungsstärke: Du bist ein exzellenter Verhandler und hast nachweislich erfolgreich Preis-, Volumen-, Kapazitäts- und Rahmenvertragsverhandlungen geführt. Kommerzielles Denken: Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge hinter einem Partnernetzwerk und steuerst konsequent entlang von Umsatz, Marge, Kapazität und Auslastung. Strategische Netzwerksteuerung: Du kannst ein wachsendes Partnernetzwerk strukturiert weiterentwickeln, Kapazitätsbedarfe frühzeitig erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für Akquise, Entwicklung und Steuerung von Partnern ableiten. Datengetriebene Steuerung: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, leitest aus Daten konkrete Handlungsfelder ab und nutzt sie, um Performance und Wirtschaftlichkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Führungserfahrung: Du bringst Führungserfahrung in der Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Teams mit und schaffst klare Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Strukturen. Ownership & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du denkst strategisch, setzt aber genauso gerne selbst um – vom wichtigen Partnergespräch und der Verhandlung bis zur Verbesserung eines operativen Prozesses. Scale-up-Mindset: Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Strukturen schnell verändern, nicht jeder Prozess bereits definiert ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern – vom Handwerksbetrieb über Großhandel und OEMs bis hin zu internen Führungskräften. Sonstiges: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools und CRM-Systemen. Most of the market treats greenfield as the risky option, the one you talk clients out of. We treat it as the fastest route to a clean core, and we run the same discipline on brownfield programmes. We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. The role You will be one of the first sellers on the team, and you own your accounts end to end — from first touch to signature. Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Bremen dein eigenes Netzwerk auf. Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen. Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise). Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann. Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss. Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt. Das bringst du mit Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit. Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort. Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken. Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn. Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln. Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein. Das erwartet dich bei uns Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm , Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching . Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein. Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad : von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen. Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst. Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit. Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone. 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio. Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision . Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate. Wie geht es weiter? Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten). Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales. Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. About the Role Our GTM org has a lot of questions. Most of the questions we care about can’t be answered by spinning up a cute dashboard. Is branded search creating new customers or capturing demand that already existed? Did the homepage redesign improve conversion, or did our traffic mix change? If we’ve got some wild ideas for our next bet, where should the money go? These kinds of big-picture questions require someone who can interrogate the metric, trace it through the warehouse, understand the business context, and turn it into action. This person will be our first Staff GTM Analyst. You’ll work alongside GTM leadership to make consequential decisions while still staying hands-on in the nitty gritty of all the data. The best part: the way we answer these questions is changing. Effective SQL is just a few tokens away, dashboards can be Claude-ed in minutes, and teammates increasingly expect to find their own answers. You’ll build the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that make self-service possible, even trustworthy, then determine where an analyst’s expertise is indispensable. You are An experienced analyst. You have roughly 8 years of hands-on, highly technical analytics experience. Most importantly: you’re backed by the pattern recognition that comes with having seen all sorts of hairy problems. You’re at the point in your career where you can take an ambiguous business question, dive head-first into the data, turn your findings into a decision, and bring everyone else along with you. A bridge between the technical and the business. You can build a model in dbt, work directly in Snowflake, and translate it into something actionable. You’ll partner closely with our Lead Analytics Engineer but you need to be willing and able to dive in and self-serve. Fluent in the quirks of GTM data. Attribution, channel definitions, UTMs, bots and broken tracking are known quantities. You don’t need to have been a dedicated GTM Analyst, but you should certainly know your way around this part of the business. Pushing the boundary of what AI means for analytics. AI is writing your first-draft SQL, analysis, and reporting and you’ve shifted that energy to bringing analysis into the future: building the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that let the team self-serve trustworthy answers. A trusted cross-functional leader. Teammates across functions and levels listen to you. You immerse yourself in the context of their needs and bridge gaps in understanding. Fiercely independent and accountable. You welcome a vague ask with aplomb. You’ll scope the problem, find the dependencies, bring in the right people, and drive the work through the analysis, recommendation…all the way to a fix. More concerned with impact than output. A polished dashboard is useful only when it changes what we do. You prioritize the questions that can materially improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue. You will Make our GTM data trustworthy. You’ll define metrics, model the funnel from first touch through paid conversion, and reconcile discrepancies across Snowflake, Segment, Amplitude, GA4, and our ad platforms. Explain what we’re seeing. Why are trials up while paid conversion isn’t? Why are Snowflake and Amplitude disagreeing? Which channel is driving volume but producing low-quality customers? jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

Others involve consolidating data across hundreds of interconnected government systems of record with overlapping schemas, deeply interdependent data flows, and significant architectural complexity. Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. The rest of the time, you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero. The role is defined by the relationship with the mission hero, not by where you sit. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.source_id: ocwen-financial-corporation-Senior Asset Manager, Commercial Special Servicing
jobs.title: Senior Asset Manager, Commercial Special Servicing
jobs.description: The Commercial Special Servicing Senior Asset Manager administers the loss mitigation, remedy enforcement and liquidation tasks for an assigned portfolio of geographically diverse, non-performing, commercial/business purpose mortgage loans secured by investor owned commercial use, mixed use, SFR/multifamily rental and/or SFR/multifamily transitional properties.The role duties include direct commercial borrower contact, assessing enforcement activities permitted under the loan documents, evaluating collateral property operations and conditions, assessing market conditions, negotiating commercial borrower workouts, directing enforcement and property vendors, including legal counsel, property managers, brokers, inspectors, etc., preparing formal business plans and status reports to investors.The position may also support Primary Commercial Servicing representatives with property and/or market analysis, borrower interaction, and investor inquiries, as appropriate. Job Functions and Responsibilities: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily: Review performing loan reports to identify commercial loans at risk of defaulting. Initiate contact with defaulted commercial loan borrowers to identify default reason and resolution plan. Assess borrower financial situation, property operations and property conditions. Review business and individual credit reports and asset search results. Review commercial loan documents for borrower requirements and lender remedies. Review servicing agreements for servicer responsibilities, authorities and deadlines. Prepare/verify calculations for legal demands. Negotiate workouts with borrowers within acceptable lender client parameters. Structure terms for loan modifications and forbearance agreements as needed. Review property valuation reports from appraisers, brokers, market sources, etc. Review/perform collateral property inspections. Prepare written business plans describing reasons for default, enforcement options, alternative strategies, and servicer recommendations based on a net present valuation analysis. Direct and monitor third-party vendors, including attorneys, inspectors, appraisers, property managers, investigators, receivers, brokers, contractors, title agents, insurance adjusters, etc., as needed. Prepare projections for asset dispositions, including recovery amounts, losses, and timelines. Provide instructions for all posting and disbursement transactions as needed. Maintain current and accurate status reports on all assigned assets. Support Commercial Primary Servicing representatives in borrower outreach efforts, market analysis and investor inquiries, as needed. Comply with all Company requirements for training, compliance, audits and reporting. Anticipate/identify issues that could impact Company/client operations and suggest solutions. Administer defaulted loan sales as appropriate. Administer complex REO activities, including, but not limited to, directing property managers and brokers, assessing property condition, preparing/reviewing budgets, etc. Monitor performance of subservicers/asset management contractors. Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor for junior staff. Complete other activities and duties as may be assigned. Key Result Areas: Establish contact with defaulted commercial loan borrowers within 5 business days of transfer to special servicing. Complete formal business plan within 45 days of transfer to special servicing. Provide written qualitative status comments on all assets no less than monthly. Update formal business plans as appropriate, but not less than every 180 days. Set and manage appropriate expectations for third party vendors. Provide appropriate instructions to other departments within agreed upon servicing level standards. Maximize recovery for lender clients. Successfully complete Company annual training requirements of not less than 40 hours. Provide SME input to training i

We're backed by world-class investors including Y Combinator, Sequoia, Alpha JWC, Rebel Fund, and Bradley Horowitz. You will manage a small team initially and are looking to grow into a manager role as the company grows. As the data team, we strive to design and build data products and systems that are reliable, scalable, and maintainable. Some of the traits that we promote within the team are ownership, curiosity, transparency, and a strong writing culture. As an early team member, you will be expected to help shape our product direction and to strengthen the team’s culture. You will collaborate closely with ML engineers, software engineers, data analysts, and sustainability experts to ship products that create value and solve problems for our customers. Assist to maintain our proprietary Carbon Database which powers the engine for emissions estimates. Design, implement and maintain data pipelines to collect, process and store data from various sources. Develop and maintain our data warehouse and other complementary data storage systems to ensure high quality data. Develop and maintain data quality checks and monitoring systems. Collaborate with data scientists and analysts as well as other teams such as sustainability to provide clean data in systems that serve internal stakeholders as well as Unravel Carbon’s customers. Lead and mentor a small team of data engineer. Stay up-to-date with the latest data engineering technologies and tools. Work on internal AI automations ABOUT YOU You have >4 years of experience in data engineering/software engineering roles in technology and data-centric businesses You have driven high business impact and shipped data engineering solutions to production. You see the potential of AI and are excited to leverage AI and build agents You can be independent in your work, planning and executing tasks with minimal guidance, depending on the task. You enjoy speaking and communicating with others across functions to better understand their needs. You thrive in an environment that is fast-paced and where everyone cares deeply. jobs.title: National Sales Director
jobs.description: Overview Who We Are Company Name : IndeVets Industry : Veterinary Staffing Our Mission : To revolutionize veterinary staffing by creating meaningful, flexible careers for veterinarians while delivering exceptional, reliable talent to hospitals, bringing balance and harmony to both sides of the care equation. Why Join IndeVets : Join a fast-growing, values-driven company at the forefront of reshaping how veterinary medicine works. Work with passionate, talented people who care deeply about quality medicine and doctor well-being. Role Snapshot Job Title : National Sales Director Department : Hospital Success Team Reports to : Senior Vice President of Growth Direct Reports : Strategic Support Managers and Territory Development Representatives Location : Remote or Hybrid (Old City, Philadelphia) What’s This Role All About? The National Sales Director leads IndeVets ’ nationwide Hospital Success Team, which includes Strategic Support Managers (SSMs) and Territory Development Representatives (TDRs). This role owns the national sales strategy and operating rhythm required to drive hospital growth, utilization, retention, and satisfaction.
